title: MyRisk - Model Implementation of a Personalized Risk Assessment and Communication Concept (CRAC) with the Aim of Future Risk-adapted Early Breast Cancer Detection within the German Mammography Screening Target Population
summary: In this multicentre, 2-arm, randomized study, shall be compared between standard counseling and a comprehensive risk and communication concept (CRAC) to be developed with the active participation of the target group for the informed decision for or against personalized risk prediction of first-time participants in the mammography screening programme aged between 50 and 54 years. The informed decision was measured using the validated Marteau instrument (Marteau et al. 2001).

interventions.name: Standard counseling for decision-making for or against personalized risk prediction for breast cancer
Developing of a risk assessment and communication concept (CRAC) for decision-making for or against personalized risk prediction for breast cancer

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Female, healthy
- First time participation in the MSP after invitation by the central office 
- Age between 50-54 years
- Informed written consent to participate in the study 
- Sufficient knowledge of the German language 
- Possibility to participate in the study online
Exclusion criteria:
- Previous participation in the MSP
- Current or previous diagnosis of breast cancer incl. DCIS 
- Presence of any other malignant tumor disease according to ICD-10 except basal cell carcinoma 
- Known pathogenic variant in a risk gene for breast cancer 
- Lack of willingness to cooperate (compliance)
- Family history of breast and ovarian cancer according to the inclusion criteria 
for familial breast cancer of the German Familial Breast and Ovarian Cancer Consortium
- Origin non-European
